pairs.target: tú shàng de mén , qiángshàng méiyǒu .
pairs.english: The door on the drawing wasn't in the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 图上的门，墙上没有。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài náncè liànxí yuànlǐ , bǎ shǒuzhōng de báozhǐ jǔ gāo , yòu fàng dī , shì zhe ràng zhǐbiān duì shàng yǎnqián de qiángjiǎo .
pairs.english: Standing in the southern practice yard, Tavi raised the thin sheet, lowered it, and tried aligning its edge with the corner ahead.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在南侧练习院里，把手中的薄纸举高，又放低，试着让纸边对上眼前的墙角。

pairs.target: qiángjiǎo cháng zhe yì cóng xì cǎo , huī zhuān cóngzuǒdàoyòu pù dé wánzhěng , lián bǔguò dòng de yánsè dōu zhǎo búdào .
pairs.english: Fine grass grew at the wall's foot; the grey bricks ran unbroken, without even the colour of a patched hole.
pairs.hanzi: 墙脚长着一丛细草，灰砖从左到右铺得完整，连补过洞的颜色都找不到。

pairs.target: " nǐ ná de shì shàngcéng tú . " dé mǎ shuō .
pairs.english: “You've got the upper-floor drawing,” Dema said.
pairs.hanzi: “你拿的是上层图。”德玛说。

pairs.target: tā fānkàn yè jiǎo . guǒrán , biāogāo hòumiàn háiyǒu yígè xiǎoxiǎode shù .
pairs.english: He checked the corner. Indeed, a tiny number followed the elevation mark.
pairs.hanzi: 他翻看页角。果然，标高后面还有一个小小的数。

pairs.target: tā zhī kànjiàn mén de wèizhì , méi zhùyì zìjǐ zhèng zhàn zài tā xiàmiàn .
pairs.english: He'd noticed the door's position, not that he stood below it.
pairs.hanzi: 他只看见门的位置，没注意自己正站在它下面。

pairs.target: zhè shì shítú kè de dìyīcì shídì kè , qíshí lián xuégōng de dàmén dōu méiyǒu chū .
pairs.english: This was their first practical chart-reading class, though they hadn't even left the academy gates.
pairs.hanzi: 这是识图课的第一次实地课，其实连学宫的大门都没有出。

pairs.target: liánxù jǐcì bǔkè zhīhòu , tǎ wéi zuò wán le xiān xiū hésuàn , cái lǐngdào zhè yìdié tú .
pairs.english: After several catch-up classes and the prerequisite calculations, Tavi had finally received these drawings.
pairs.hanzi: 连续几次补课之后，塔维做完了先修核算，才领到这一叠图。

pairs.target: nányuàn zǎoyǐ tíng zuò kù chǎng , jiù qìjù bān kōng , zhī shèng jǐduàn zhuānqiáng hé dā chūlái de mù tái , gòng xuéshēng rèn wèizhì ;
pairs.english: The south yard no longer stored equipment; everything had been removed except brick walls and wooden platforms for students to locate themselves.
pairs.hanzi: 南院早已停作库场，旧器具搬空，只剩几段砖墙和搭出来的木台，供学生认位置；

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī shuō , jīntiān shuí yě bù xūyào bǎ tiěpiàn mō rè .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian said nobody needed to warm an iron strip with their hands today.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师说，今天谁也不需要把铁片摸热。

alignment.english: warm an iron strip with their hands

pairs.target: yīwén shì lái liàn cèhuì de , bú zuò jiè xìng .
pairs.english: Iven was practising surveying, not exchange.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文是来练测绘的，不做借性。

pairs.target: tā zhàn zài gāo yìdiǎn de mù táishàng , cháo xiàmiàn huī zhǐ , wèn liǎnggè rén yào buyào kàn zhēnzhèng de mén .
pairs.english: From a higher platform he waved a sheet down at them, asking if they'd like to see the actual door.
pairs.hanzi: 他站在高一点的木台上，朝下面挥纸，问两个人要不要看真正的门。

pairs.target: mù tái jìntóu héng zhe yídào kōng kuàng , hòumiàn méiyǒu fángzi , zhǐyǒu lìng yì jié xiàngxià de tīzǐ .
pairs.english: An empty frame crossed the platform's end, with no house behind it, just another stair going down.
pairs.hanzi: 木台尽头横着一道空框，后面没有房子，只有另一截向下的梯子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zǒushàng qù , zhōngyú bǎ túlǐ de mén hé shíwù duì shàng .
pairs.english: Tavi climbed up and finally matched the drawn door to the real one.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维走上去，终于把图里的门和实物对上。

pairs.target: mén cóng zhèngmiàn kàn hěn pǔtōng , wǎng lìngyìbiān kàn , què zhǐshì yìtiáo qùwǎng biéchù de lù .
pairs.english: Ordinary from the front, it was, from the other side, simply a way somewhere else.
pairs.hanzi: 门从正面看很普通，往另一边看，却只是一条去往别处的路。

pairs.target: yuánxiān qiáng xiàmiàn nà tuán " méiyǒu ", hūrán zài jiǎoxià biànde yǒu le hòudù .
pairs.english: That earlier “nothing” below the wall suddenly gained depth beneath his feet.
pairs.hanzi: 原先墙下面那团“没有”，忽然在脚下变得有了厚度。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng fēnkāi , měirén fāliǎngzhāng bùtóng niándài de tú ,
pairs.english: Jian separated the students and gave each two drawings from different periods,
pairs.hanzi: 简老师把学生分开，每人发两张不同年代的图，

pairs.target: yào tāmen zhǎodào tóngyígè jiǎnxiū kǒu , xiěmíng nǎ yíduàn kànjiàn le , nǎ yíduàn zhǐshì zhào tú cāi de .
pairs.english: asking them to find the same inspection opening and record what they saw versus what they inferred from the drawings.
pairs.hanzi: 要他们找到同一个检修口，写明哪一段看见了，哪一段只是照图猜的。

pairs.target: bùnéng yīnwèi zǎo dào jiù shěngdiào hòu bànzhāng zhǐ .
pairs.english: Arriving early didn't excuse skipping the rest of the sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 不能因为早到就省掉后半张纸。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi nádào de jiù tú shàng huà zhe yìtiáo zhíxiàn . xīn tú duōchū yígè fāngkuàng ,
pairs.english: Tavi's old drawing showed a straight line; the newer one added a square.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维拿到的旧图上画着一条直线。新图多出一个方框，

pairs.target: tā qǐxiān yǐwéi shì hòulái tiān de fángjiān , yán qiáng rào le bànquān , fāxiàn fāngkuàng lǐ zhàn zhe yìkēshù .
pairs.english: At first he thought it was a later room, but halfway around the wall found a tree standing in the square.
pairs.hanzi: 他起先以为是后来添的房间，沿墙绕了半圈，发现方框里站着一棵树。

pairs.target: dé mǎ bǐ tā xiān dào . tā yòng shǒulǐ de duǎnshéng bǐ le yíxià qiángjiǎo jùlí , zhǐxiàng shù bèihòu bàn mái zài tǔ lǐ de yuánshí gài .
pairs.english: Dema was there first. Measuring from the corner with her short cord, she pointed behind the tree to a round stone cover half buried in soil.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛比他先到。她用手里的短绳比了一下墙角距离，指向树背后半埋在土里的圆石盖。

pairs.target: " nǐ zěnme zhīdào shì zhèbiān ? " " tú dǎo guòlái kàn . "
pairs.english: “How did you know this side?” “Look at the drawing backwards.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你怎么知道是这边？”
“图倒过来看。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zhǐ zhuǎn le bànquān , lù gèng luàn le .
pairs.english: Tavi turned the paper halfway round; the route grew more confusing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把纸转了半圈，路更乱了。

pairs.target: dé mǎ xiào zhe qiǎngguòlái , búshì ràng tā bǎ dōng dāng xī , érshì jiào tā zhàn dàolái lù de lìngyìbiān .
pairs.english: Laughing, Dema took it: she meant he should stand on the other side of the approach, not exchange east and west.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛笑着抢过来，不是让他把东当西，而是叫他站到来路的另一边。

pairs.target: liǎngzhāng tú de huàfǎ bùtóng , yìzhāng cóng jiēkǒu wǎng lǐ , yìzhāng cóng yuànlǐ wǎng wài , jiàntóu què hái gèzì cháozhe jiù de fāngxiàng .
pairs.english: The drawings differed: one looked in from the street, one out from the yard, while their arrows kept the old directions.
pairs.hanzi: 两张图的画法不同，一张从街口往里，一张从院里往外，箭头却还各自朝着旧的方向。

pairs.target: tāmen méiyǒu jiē shí gài . gài biān yǒu yídào lǎoshī huà de báixiàn , guāncè dào zhèlǐ jiù gòu .
pairs.english: They didn't lift the cover. A teacher's white line beside it marked the end of their observations.
pairs.hanzi: 他们没有揭石盖。盖边有一道老师划的白线，观测到这里就够。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dūnxiàlái , kànjiàn shùgēn cóng gài páng rào chūqù , gēn shàng yā zhe yípiàn shēngxiù de jiù tiěpí .
pairs.english: Crouching, Tavi saw roots winding past the cover, with a rusty sheet of iron pressed on a root.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维蹲下来，看见树根从盖旁绕出去，根上压着一片生锈的旧铁皮。

pairs.target: tiěpí búshì jīntiān tí lǐ yào zhǎo de dōngxī , què ràng tā xiǎngdào gàizi mái zài zhèlǐ de shíhòu , shù yěxǔ hái méiyǒu xiànzài zhème cū .
pairs.english: It wasn't part of today's question, but made him think the tree might have been thinner when the cover was buried here.
pairs.hanzi: 铁皮不是今天题里要找的东西，却让他想到盖子埋在这里的时候，树也许还没有现在这么粗。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī guòlái , kàn le tā de jìlù , wèn zhíxiàn zài xiànshí lǐ shìbushì yídìng zhí .
pairs.english: Jian came, read his notes, and asked whether a straight line was always straight in reality.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师过来，看了他的记录，问直线在现实里是不是一定直。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běn xiǎng huídá búshì , hūrán yǒudiǎnfán .
pairs.english: Tavi meant to say no, then suddenly felt irritated.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本想回答不是，忽然有点烦。

pairs.target: yílù zǒulái tā yǐjīng zhīdào zìjǐ huì cuò , bùxiǎng měijùhuà dōu xiàng zài děng biérén tì tā zhǐchū .
pairs.english: He already knew he could be wrong; he didn't want every sentence to wait for someone to point it out.
pairs.hanzi: 一路走来他已经知道自己会错，不想每句话都像在等别人替他指出。

pairs.target: " tú shàng zhègēn xiàn , dàodǐ huà de shì lù , háishì jiè xìng chuán guòqù de fāngxiàng ? " tā fǎnwèn .
pairs.english: “Does this line show a road, or the direction an exchange travels?” he asked back.
pairs.hanzi: “图上这根线，到底画的是路，还是借性传过去的方向？”他反问。

pairs.target: lǎoshī méi lìjí huídá , xiān bǎ tā shǒulǐ de liǎngzhāng zhǐ tāndào mù táishàng .
pairs.english: Rather than answer immediately, the teacher spread both sheets on the platform.
pairs.hanzi: 老师没立即回答，先把他手里的两张纸摊到木台上。

pairs.target: jiù tú de xiàn páng yǒu yìháng hěnxiǎo de zì , xiě zhe jiǎnxiū tōngxíng ; xīn tú yòng le lìng yìzhǒng xiàn , biāodì shì gòujiàn jiān de liánxì .
pairs.english: Tiny words beside the old line said “maintenance access”; the new drawing used another line for connections between components.
pairs.hanzi: 旧图的线旁有一行很小的字，写着检修通行；新图用了另一种线，标的是构件间的联系。

pairs.target: huà de rén bǎ shù shěngdiào le , yě bǎ yǒurén néng bunéng chuān guòqù shěngdiào le .
pairs.english: Its maker had left out the tree, and whether anyone could pass through.
pairs.hanzi: 画的人把树省掉了，也把有人能不能穿过去省掉了。

pairs.target: " nǐ zhège wèntí , zhídé xiě zài jìlù qiánmiàn . " jiǎn lǎoshī shuō , " gāngcái nàge dáàn , búbì jí zhe jiāogěi wǒ . "
pairs.english: “That question belongs at the beginning of your record,” Jian said. “Don't rush to give me the other answer.”
pairs.hanzi: “你这个问题，值得写在记录前面。”简老师说，“刚才那个答案，不必急着交给我。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu , chóngxīn kàn nà liǎnggè bùtóng de xiàntóu .
pairs.english: Tavi studied the two different line ends again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头，重新看那两个不同的线头。

pairs.target: yīwén zài pángbiān còu guòlái , kàn le yíhuìer , zhǐzhe xīn túshuō , yàoshi bǎ tā dāng lù zǒu , rén jiù dé cóng shùgàn lǐ chuān guòqù .
pairs.english: Iven leaned in, looked, and said following the new drawing as a path would mean walking through the tree trunk.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文在旁边凑过来，看了一会儿，指着新图说，要是把它当路走，人就得从树干里穿过去。

pairs.target: dé mǎ shuō xiān qǐng tā shìfàn , sāngè rén dōu xiào le , tǎ wéi xiōngkǒu nà diǎn mēnqì cái sànkāi .
pairs.english: Dema invited him to demonstrate first. All three laughed, and Tavi's tight feeling eased.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛说先请他示范，三个人都笑了，塔维胸口那点闷气才散开。

pairs.target: shōu kèshí , jiǎn lǎoshī xuānbù shítiān hòu yǒu yícì fēnzǔ xúnlù yǎnliàn .
pairs.english: At the end, Jian announced a team navigation exercise in ten days.
pairs.hanzi: 收课时，简老师宣布十天后有一次分组寻路演练。

pairs.target: chǎngdì réng zài zhèxiē tíngyòng de yuànluò , yóu lǎoshī tíqián huà fànwéi , xuéshēng kěyǐ zìjǐ zhǎo duìyǒu .
pairs.english: It would use these disused courtyards, with boundaries marked beforehand by teachers; students could choose teammates.
pairs.hanzi: 场地仍在这些停用的院落，由老师提前划范围，学生可以自己找队友。

pairs.target: yào dài de shì kàndédǒng de tú hé jiāo dé qīngchǔ de jìlù , búshì huì pǎo de tuǐ .
pairs.english: They needed readable maps and clear records, not running legs.
pairs.hanzi: 要带的是看得懂的图和交得清楚的记录，不是会跑的腿。

pairs.target: yīwén lìkè wèn tǎ wéi . tǎ wéi hái méi dá , dé mǎ yǐjīng shuō zìjǐ gēn luò héng yìzǔ , tāmen zuótiān jiù tán guò le .
pairs.english: Iven immediately asked Tavi. Before he could answer, Dema said she was with Lohen; they'd agreed yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文立刻问塔维。塔维还没答，德玛已经说自己跟洛衡一组，他们昨天就谈过了。

pairs.target: tā shuōwán cháo liǎnggè rén huīhuīshǒu , kuàibù qù zhuī qiánmiàn de tóngbàn , méiyǒu děng shuí bǎ tā liúxià .
pairs.english: She waved to them and hurried after her companions, not waiting to be asked to stay.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完朝两个人挥挥手，快步去追前面的同伴，没有等谁把她留下。

pairs.target: huí dōng wū , mǐlā zhèng shōuqǐ lùjī móxíng .
pairs.english: Back in the east room, Mira was packing her roadbed model.
pairs.hanzi: 回东屋，米拉正收起路基模型。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng bǎ zhècì xúnlù yòngzuò jiǎnyàn , kànkàn zìjǐ huà de táijiē hé zhuǎnwān , biérén shìbushì zhēn néng zhàozhe zǒu .
pairs.english: She wanted the exercise to test whether other people could really follow her stairs and turns on paper.
pairs.hanzi: 她想把这次寻路用作检验，看看自己画的台阶和转弯，别人是不是真能照着走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dāying bāng tā bān dǐbǎn , yuē zài wǔtiān hòu xiàwǔ , xiān qù xīcè de xiǎopéng qǔ cún zhe de mùpiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi agreed to help her carry the baseboard five afternoons later, first collecting stored wood from the western shed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维答应帮她搬底板，约在五天后下午，先去西侧的小棚取存着的木片。

pairs.target: tā bǎ shíjiān jì dào shūyè zuì shàngmiàn .
pairs.english: He wrote the time at the top of a page.
pairs.hanzi: 他把时间记到书页最上面。

pairs.target: xiàmiàn shì jīntiān xīn xiě de yìháng : xiān nòngqīngchǔ xiàn huà de shì shénme .
pairs.english: Below it was today's new line: First understand what the line represents.
pairs.hanzi: 下面是今天新写的一行：先弄清楚线画的是什么。

pairs.target: mǐlā dúwán , bǎ nà yè zhǐ zhuǎn huílái , wèn tā zhè zì shìbushì zhàn zài shùshàng xiě de .
pairs.english: Mira read it, turned the paper back, and asked if he'd written those characters standing in the tree.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉读完，把那页纸转回来，问他这字是不是站在树上写的。
